'
Nard
is the debut album from
American
funk
keyboardist
Bernard Wright
. It was released in 1981 by
GRP Records
and distributed by
Arista Records
. The album reached number 7 on the Jazz Albums chart in the US.

In popular culture
The song "Haboglabotribin" is featured in
Grand Theft Auto V
on the radio station Space 103.2. The song is also featured in the trailer for the Enhanced Edition of the game, which was shown during Sony's
PlayStation 5
reveal event.
